mapper.select: select t.user_id as userId, coalesce(nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username) as nickname, u.username as username, u.avatar as avatar, t.pts as points from (select user_id, sum(points) as pts from life_points_record where deleted = 0 and points > 0 and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < #{end} group by user_id order by pts desc, user_id asc limit #{offset}, #{limit}) t join life_user u on u.id = t.user_id and u.deleted = 0

select case when coalesce(my.p, 0) <= 0 then 0 else (select count(*) + 1 from (select user_id, sum(points) as p from life_points_record where deleted = 0 and points > 0 and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < #{end} group by user_id) board where board.p > my.p) end from (select coalesce(sum(points), 0) as p from life_points_record where deleted = 0 and points > 0 and user_id = #{userId} and create_time >= #{start} and create_time < #{end}) my
